description:
Rust 驱动的多协议下载管理器，支持 HTTP/FTP/BitTorrent 磁力链接及 HLS/DASH 流媒体，智能多线程加速与浏览器无缝集成。精美界面，极致性能，永久免费，零广告。


[0.4.4] - 2026-08-14
🚀 新功能
- 下载列表支持批量选择：Ctrl/Cmd+点击勾选单个任务、Shift+点击选中区间、鼠标拖动框选批量任务，拖动到列表边缘会自动滚动
- 设置页新增「推介有奖」入口，登录后可查看收益总览、管理推荐码、查询返利台账；活动说明由云端远程配置，支持 Markdown 富文本并实时更新
- 会员套餐徽标现在会缓存到本地，启动应用即可立刻看到上次的套餐标识，不再先显示默认样式再刷新
- 注册页密码输入框新增明文切换按钮，方便核对输入
- 点击搜索结果可直接跳转并高亮定位到对应任务，列表会自动展开分组并滚动到屏幕居中位置
- 购买套餐因参与推介活动被排除时，会显示明确的提示文案
🐛 问题修复
- 修复 Webhook 通知预设（如 Server酱³）在消息中包含 URL 或空格时被错误编码为 %2F、+ 等符号的问题，通知预设已统一改用 JSON 请求体发送
- 修复深色主题下「回到顶部」按钮背景为白色、观感刺眼的问题，现在跟随主题配色
- 修复搜索框获得焦点时按 Cmd+A 会全选任务列表而非选中输入内容的问题
[0.4.4] - 2026-08-14
🚀 Features
- Batch selection in the download list: Ctrl/Cmd+click to toggle a single task, Shift+click to select a range, and click-and-drag to box-select multiple tasks, with auto-scroll when dragging near the list edges
- A new "Referral Rewards" entry in Settings (visible after sign-in) showing earnings overview, referral code management, and rebate history; the campaign description is fetched from the cloud and supports Markdown, always showing the latest content
- Membership plan badges are now cached locally, so they render instantly on cold start instead of briefly showing a default placeholder before refreshing
- Added a show/hide toggle for the password field on the sign-up screen
- Clicking a search result now jumps straight to the matching task, auto-expanding its group and scrolling it to the center of the list
- A clear message is now shown when a plan purchase is excluded from an active referral promotion
🐛 Bug Fixes
- Fixed webhook notification presets (e.g. Server酱³) mangling URLs or spaces in messages into %2F, +, and similar sequences — presets now send JSON bodies consistently
- Fixed the "back to top" button showing a jarring white background in dark theme; it now follows the app's theme color
- Fixed Cmd+A selecting all tasks in the list instead of the text when the search box was focused
